import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from pathlib import Path
from itertools import product
from prophet import Prophet

from IPython.display import display

plt.rcParams["figure.figsize"] = (12, 5)
plt.rcParams["axes.grid"] = True

# -------------------------
# Config
# -------------------------
DATA_PATH = "retail_store_inventory.csv"

DATE_COL = "Date"
TARGET_COL = "Units Sold"
ID_COLS = ["Store ID", "Product ID"]

VAL_HORIZON_DAYS = 28
TEST_HORIZON_DAYS = 28
MIN_TRAIN_DAYS = 60   # tối thiểu số ngày train để fit Prophet ổn hơn

MAX_SERIES = None     # None = chạy tất cả, hoặc set int để debug

# Hyperparameter tuning (global) trên sample series
DO_HYPERPARAM_TUNING = True
TUNING_SAMPLE_SERIES = 8   # số series dùng để tune (lấy theo độ dài giảm dần)

# Param grid (nhỏ để chạy ổn). Bạn có thể mở rộng nếu muốn.
PARAM_GRID = {
    "changepoint_prior_scale": [0.05, 0.5],
    "seasonality_mode": ["additive", "multiplicative"],
    "holidays_prior_scale": [1.0, 10.0],
}

RANDOM_SEED = 42
np.random.seed(RANDOM_SEED)

# -------------------------
# Metrics helpers
# -------------------------
def rmse(y_true, y_pred):
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=float)
    y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred, dtype=float)
    return float(np.sqrt(np.mean((y_true - y_pred) ** 2)))

def mape(y_true, y_pred):
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=float)
    y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred, dtype=float)
    mask = y_true != 0
    if not np.any(mask):
        return np.nan
    return float(np.mean(np.abs((y_true[mask] - y_pred[mask]) / y_true[mask])) * 100)

def smape(y_true, y_pred):
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=float)
    y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred, dtype=float)
    denom = np.abs(y_true) + np.abs(y_pred)
    mask = denom != 0
    if not np.any(mask):
        return np.nan
    return float(2.0 * np.mean(np.abs(y_true[mask] - y_pred[mask]) / denom[mask]) * 100)

def wape(y_true, y_pred):
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=float)
    y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred, dtype=float)
    denom = np.sum(np.abs(y_true))
    if denom == 0:
        return np.nan
    return float(np.sum(np.abs(y_true - y_pred)) / denom * 100)

def evaluate_forecast(y_true, y_pred):
    return {
        "rmse": rmse(y_true, y_pred),
        "mape": mape(y_true, y_pred),
        "smape": smape(y_true, y_pred),
        "wape": wape(y_true, y_pred),
    }

# -------------------------
# Load data
# -------------------------
candidate_paths = [
    Path(DATA_PATH),
    Path("../input/retail-store-inventory-forecasting-dataset/retail_store_inventory.csv"),
]
data_path = next((p for p in candidate_paths if p.is_file()), None)
if data_path is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError("Không tìm thấy CSV. Hãy kiểm tra DATA_PATH hoặc đường dẫn Kaggle input.")

print(f"Using data file: {data_path.resolve()}")

df = pd.read_csv(data_path)
print("Raw shape:", df.shape)

df[DATE_COL] = pd.to_datetime(df[DATE_COL])
df = df.sort_values(ID_COLS + [DATE_COL]).reset_index(drop=True)

# Basic cleaning numeric columns (nếu có)
numeric_cols = [
    "Units Sold",
    "Inventory Level",
    "Price",
    "Competitor Pricing",
    "Discount",
    "Demand Forecast",
]
for col in numeric_cols:
    if col in df.columns:
        df[col] = (
            df[col].astype(str)
                 .str.replace(",", "", regex=False)
                 .replace("nan", np.nan)
        )
        df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

df.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan, inplace=True)
df.dropna(subset=[TARGET_COL], inplace=True)

print("Cleaned shape:", df.shape)
display(df.head())

# -------------------------
# Feature engineering per series
# -------------------------
CAT_COL_CANDIDATES = ["Weather Condition", "Seasonality", "Region", "Category"]

NUMERIC_REG_CANDIDATES = [
    "Price",
    "Discount",
    "Competitor Pricing",
    "Demand Forecast",
    "Inventory Level",
]

def build_model_df_for_series(df, store_id, product_id):
    ts = df[(df["Store ID"] == store_id) & (df["Product ID"] == product_id)].copy()
    ts = ts.sort_values(DATE_COL).set_index(DATE_COL)
    ts = ts.asfreq("D")

    # Target
    ts[TARGET_COL] = ts[TARGET_COL].fillna(0.0).astype(float)

    # Fill numeric regressors
    for col in NUMERIC_REG_CANDIDATES:
        if col in ts.columns:
            if col == "Inventory Level":
                ts[col] = ts[col].ffill().fillna(0.0)
            else:
                med = ts[col].median()
                ts[col] = ts[col].ffill().fillna(med if pd.notna(med) else 0.0)

    # Calendar features
    ts["dow"] = ts.index.dayofweek
    ts["month"] = ts.index.month

    # Categorical one-hot
    cat_cols = [c for c in CAT_COL_CANDIDATES if c in ts.columns]
    if cat_cols:
        for c in cat_cols:
            ts[c] = ts[c].ffill().fillna("Unknown").astype(str)
        ts_cat = pd.get_dummies(ts[cat_cols].astype("category"), drop_first=True)
    else:
        ts_cat = pd.DataFrame(index=ts.index)

    numeric_reg_cols = [c for c in NUMERIC_REG_CANDIDATES if c in ts.columns]
    cal_cols = ["dow", "month"]

    pieces = []
    pieces.append(ts[[TARGET_COL]].rename(columns={TARGET_COL: "y"}))
    if numeric_reg_cols:
        pieces.append(ts[numeric_reg_cols])
    if not ts_cat.empty:
        pieces.append(ts_cat)
    pieces.append(ts[cal_cols])

    # Holiday/Promotion if present
    if "Holiday/Promotion" in ts.columns:
        pieces.append(ts[["Holiday/Promotion"]].fillna(0).astype(int))

    model_df = pd.concat(pieces, axis=1)
    model_df = model_df.reset_index().rename(columns={DATE_COL: "ds"})

    # Regressors for Prophet
    regressor_cols = [c for c in model_df.columns if c not in ["ds", "y", "Holiday/Promotion"]]

    # Naive-7 for baseline only
    model_df["y_lag_7"] = model_df["y"].shift(7)

    return model_df, regressor_cols

def build_holidays_df(model_df):
    if "Holiday/Promotion" not in model_df.columns:
        return None
    h = model_df.loc[model_df["Holiday/Promotion"] == 1, ["ds"]].drop_duplicates()
    if h.empty:
        return None
    h = h.copy()
    h["holiday"] = "promotion"
    h["lower_window"] = 0
    h["upper_window"] = 0
    return h

def split_train_val_test(model_df):
    model_df = model_df.sort_values("ds").reset_index(drop=True)
    total_len = len(model_df)

    min_len_required = VAL_HORIZON_DAYS + TEST_HORIZON_DAYS + MIN_TRAIN_DAYS
    if total_len < min_len_required:
        return None, None, None, f"too_short({total_len}<{min_len_required})"

    train_end = total_len - (VAL_HORIZON_DAYS + TEST_HORIZON_DAYS)
    val_end = total_len - TEST_HORIZON_DAYS

    train_df = model_df.iloc[:train_end].copy()
    val_df = model_df.iloc[train_end:val_end].copy()
    test_df = model_df.iloc[val_end:].copy()

    return train_df, val_df, test_df, None

# -------------------------
# Hyperparameter tuning (global) on sample series
# -------------------------
all_params = [dict(zip(PARAM_GRID.keys(), v)) for v in product(*PARAM_GRID.values())]

def fit_predict_prophet(train_df, pred_df, regressor_cols, holidays_df, params):
    m = Prophet(
        growth="linear",
        weekly_seasonality=True,
        yearly_seasonality=True,
        changepoint_prior_scale=params["changepoint_prior_scale"],
        seasonality_mode=params["seasonality_mode"],
        holidays_prior_scale=params["holidays_prior_scale"],
        holidays=holidays_df,
    )
    for reg in regressor_cols:
        m.add_regressor(reg)

    m.fit(train_df[["ds","y"] + regressor_cols])

    fc = m.predict(pred_df[["ds"] + regressor_cols])
    return fc["yhat"].values

best_params = {
    "changepoint_prior_scale": 0.05,
    "seasonality_mode": "additive",
    "holidays_prior_scale": 1.0,
}
tuning_rows = []

if DO_HYPERPARAM_TUNING and len(tuning_keys) > 0:
    print("Starting Prophet hyperparameter tuning on sample series...\n")
    best_score = np.inf

    for i, params in enumerate(all_params, start=1):
        rmses = []
        ok = 0
        fail = 0

        for (store_id, product_id) in tuning_keys:
            model_df, regressor_cols = build_model_df_for_series(df, store_id, product_id)
            holidays_df = build_holidays_df(model_df)
            train_df, val_df, test_df, err = split_train_val_test(model_df)
            if err is not None:
                continue

            try:
                yhat_val = fit_predict_prophet(train_df, val_df, regressor_cols, holidays_df, params)
                y_true = val_df["y"].values
                rmses.append(rmse(y_true, yhat_val))
                ok += 1
            except Exception:
                fail += 1

        mean_rmse = float(np.mean(rmses)) if len(rmses) else np.inf
        tuning_rows.append({
            **params,
            "val_rmse_mean": mean_rmse,
            "n_ok": ok,
            "n_fail": fail,
        })

        print(f"Config {i}/{len(all_params)} => mean Val RMSE = {mean_rmse:.4f} (ok={ok}, fail={fail})")

        if mean_rmse < best_score:
            best_score = mean_rmse
            best_params = params

    tuning_df = pd.DataFrame(tuning_rows).sort_values("val_rmse_mean")
    print("\nBest params:", best_params)
    display(tuning_df.head(10))
else:
    tuning_df = pd.DataFrame(tuning_rows)
    print("Skip tuning. Using default best_params:", best_params)

# -------------------------
# Run Prophet over ALL series and average metrics
# -------------------------
rows = []
skipped_short = 0
failed_fit = 0

for (store_id, product_id) in series_keys:
    model_df, regressor_cols = build_model_df_for_series(df, store_id, product_id)
    holidays_df = build_holidays_df(model_df)
    train_df, val_df, test_df, err = split_train_val_test(model_df)

    row = {
        "Store ID": store_id,
        "Product ID": product_id,
        "total_days": int(len(model_df)),
    }

    if err is not None:
        skipped_short += 1
        row.update({"status": f"skipped_{err}"})
        rows.append(row)
        continue

    # Baseline Naive-7 (test)
    y_pred_base = test_df["y_lag_7"].values.astype(float)
    if np.isnan(y_pred_base).any():
        fallback = float(np.nanmean(model_df["y_lag_7"].values))
        y_pred_base = np.where(np.isnan(y_pred_base), fallback, y_pred_base)

    base_metrics = evaluate_forecast(test_df["y"].values, y_pred_base)
    row.update({f"naive7_{k}": v for k, v in base_metrics.items()})

    # Prophet (fit on train+val, test)
    try:
        train_val_df = pd.concat([train_df, val_df], axis=0).reset_index(drop=True)

        m_final = Prophet(
            growth="linear",
            weekly_seasonality=True,
            yearly_seasonality=True,
            changepoint_prior_scale=best_params["changepoint_prior_scale"],
            seasonality_mode=best_params["seasonality_mode"],
            holidays_prior_scale=best_params["holidays_prior_scale"],
            holidays=holidays_df,
        )
        for reg in regressor_cols:
            m_final.add_regressor(reg)

        m_final.fit(train_val_df[["ds","y"] + regressor_cols])

        test_forecast = m_final.predict(test_df[["ds"] + regressor_cols])
        yhat_test = test_forecast["yhat"].values.astype(float)

        pr_metrics = evaluate_forecast(test_df["y"].values, yhat_test)

        row.update({
            "status": "ok",
            **{f"prophet_{k}": v for k, v in pr_metrics.items()},
        })
    except Exception as e:
        failed_fit += 1
        row.update({
            "status": "failed_fit",
            "prophet_rmse": np.nan,
            "prophet_mape": np.nan,
            "prophet_smape": np.nan,
            "prophet_wape": np.nan,
            "error": str(e)[:300],
        })

    rows.append(row)

results_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

print("Done.")
print("Series OK:", int((results_df["status"] == "ok").sum()))
print("Skipped (short):", skipped_short)
print("Failed fit:", failed_fit)

display(results_df.head())

# -------------------------
# Average metrics across all series (test)
# -------------------------
metric_cols = [
    "naive7_rmse","naive7_mape","naive7_smape","naive7_wape",
    "prophet_rmse","prophet_mape","prophet_smape","prophet_wape",
]

summary = results_df.loc[results_df["status"] == "ok", metric_cols].mean(numeric_only=True)
summary_df = summary.to_frame(name="mean_over_series").reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "metric"})

print("Average metrics (mean over all OK series):")
display(summary_df)

# Export
output_dir = Path("outputs_prophet_allseries")
output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

results_path = output_dir / "prophet_per_series_metrics.csv"
summary_path = output_dir / "prophet_mean_metrics.csv"
params_path = output_dir / "prophet_best_params.json"
tuning_path = output_dir / "prophet_tuning_table.csv"

results_df.to_csv(results_path, index=False)
summary_df.to_csv(summary_path, index=False)

import json
with open(params_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(best_params, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

if "tuning_df" in globals() and isinstance(tuning_df, pd.DataFrame) and len(tuning_df):
    tuning_df.to_csv(tuning_path, index=False)

print("Saved:", results_path.resolve())
print("Saved:", summary_path.resolve())
print("Saved:", params_path.resolve())
if (output_dir / "prophet_tuning_table.csv").is_file():
    print("Saved:", tuning_path.resolve())

# -------------------------
# Plots trên chuỗi TRUNG BÌNH (mean của tất cả series)
# -------------------------
import json

# Build mean model_df by date (mean target + mean numeric + fractions for one-hot cats)
date_idx = pd.to_datetime(df[DATE_COL])
df2 = df.copy()
df2[DATE_COL] = pd.to_datetime(df2[DATE_COL])

mean_base = (
    df2.groupby(DATE_COL)[TARGET_COL]
       .mean()
       .sort_index()
       .to_frame("y")
       .asfreq("D")
)
mean_base["y"] = mean_base["y"].fillna(0.0)

# Calendar regressors
mean_base = mean_base.reset_index().rename(columns={DATE_COL: "ds"})
mean_base["dow"] = mean_base["ds"].dt.dayofweek
mean_base["month"] = mean_base["ds"].dt.month
mean_base = mean_base.set_index("ds")

# Numeric regressors (mean by date)
for col in NUMERIC_REG_CANDIDATES:
    if col in df2.columns:
        s = df2.groupby(DATE_COL)[col].mean().sort_index().asfreq("D")
        s = s.ffill()
        med = float(np.nanmedian(s.values)) if np.any(~np.isnan(s.values)) else 0.0
        mean_base[col] = s.reindex(mean_base.index).ffill().fillna(med)

# Categorical one-hot fractions by date
cat_cols = [c for c in CAT_COL_CANDIDATES if c in df2.columns]
if cat_cols:
    cat_df = df2[[DATE_COL] + cat_cols].copy()
    for c in cat_cols:
        cat_df[c] = cat_df[c].fillna("Unknown").astype(str)
    dummies = pd.get_dummies(cat_df[cat_cols].astype("category"), drop_first=True)
    dummies[DATE_COL] = cat_df[DATE_COL]
    dum_mean = dummies.groupby(DATE_COL).mean().sort_index().asfreq("D").fillna(0.0)
    dum_mean.index = pd.to_datetime(dum_mean.index)
    mean_base = mean_base.join(dum_mean, how="left").fillna(0.0)

# Holiday/Promotion flag: dùng max theo ngày (nếu ngày đó có bất kỳ series nào là promo)
if "Holiday/Promotion" in df2.columns:
    promo = df2.groupby(DATE_COL)["Holiday/Promotion"].max().sort_index().asfreq("D").fillna(0).astype(int)
    promo.index = pd.to_datetime(promo.index)
    mean_base["Holiday/Promotion"] = promo.reindex(mean_base.index).fillna(0).astype(int)
else:
    mean_base["Holiday/Promotion"] = 0

model_df_mean = mean_base.reset_index()
holidays_mean = build_holidays_df(model_df_mean)

train_m, val_m, test_m, err = split_train_val_test(model_df_mean)
if err is not None:
    print("Mean series too short for (train/val/test) split:", err)
else:
    train_val_m = pd.concat([train_m, val_m], axis=0).reset_index(drop=True)

    reg_cols_mean = [c for c in model_df_mean.columns if c not in ["ds", "y", "Holiday/Promotion"]]

    m_mean = Prophet(
        growth="linear",
        weekly_seasonality=True,
        yearly_seasonality=True,
        changepoint_prior_scale=best_params["changepoint_prior_scale"],
        seasonality_mode=best_params["seasonality_mode"],
        holidays_prior_scale=best_params["holidays_prior_scale"],
        holidays=holidays_mean,
    )
    for r in reg_cols_mean:
        m_mean.add_regressor(r)

    m_mean.fit(train_val_m[["ds","y"] + reg_cols_mean])

    # Fit on full history (for visualization)
    fc_hist = m_mean.predict(model_df_mean[["ds"] + reg_cols_mean])

    plt.figure(figsize=(12,5))
    plt.plot(model_df_mean["ds"], model_df_mean["y"], label="Actual (mean)")
    plt.plot(fc_hist["ds"], fc_hist["yhat"], label="Prophet fitted (mean)")
    plt.title(f"Mean series: Prophet fitted on average across all Store×Product")
    plt.xlabel("Date")
    plt.ylabel(f"Mean {TARGET_COL}")
    plt.legend()
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    # Forecast into the future (same horizon as TEST_HORIZON_DAYS)
    horizon = int(TEST_HORIZON_DAYS)
    last_date = model_df_mean["ds"].max()
    future_dates = pd.date_range(last_date + pd.Timedelta(days=1), periods=horizon, freq="D")

    last_row = model_df_mean.iloc[-1]
    future_reg = pd.DataFrame({"ds": future_dates})
    for r in reg_cols_mean:
        if r == "dow":
            future_reg["dow"] = future_reg["ds"].dt.dayofweek
        elif r == "month":
            future_reg["month"] = future_reg["ds"].dt.month
        else:
            future_reg[r] = last_row[r]

    future_fc = m_mean.predict(future_reg[["ds"] + reg_cols_mean])
    full_fc = pd.concat([fc_hist, future_fc], axis=0, ignore_index=True)

    plt.figure(figsize=(12,5))
    plt.plot(model_df_mean["ds"], model_df_mean["y"], label="Actual (mean)")
    plt.plot(full_fc["ds"], full_fc["yhat"], label="Forecast (mean)")
    try:
        plt.fill_between(full_fc["ds"], full_fc["yhat_lower"], full_fc["yhat_upper"], alpha=0.2)
    except Exception:
        pass
    plt.title(f"Mean series: History + {horizon}-day forecast (Prophet)")
    plt.xlabel("Date")
    plt.ylabel(f"Mean {TARGET_COL}")
    plt.legend()
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    _ = m_mean.plot_components(full_fc)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
